Management Commentary
“Our Quarterly revenue has crossed ₹1500 Cr in Q2 FY27 with EBITDA of ₹338 Cr,
despite higher input and logistics costs from tensions in West Asia. Cost pressures will
persist and we are working with customers to manage them with a lag. We filed two
potential first-to-file ANDAs in H1, which makes it a total of three potential first to file
ANDAs and continue to shift towards complex generics and peptide CDMO. With the
balance warrant proceeds received, we hold net cash of ₹828 Cr to invest in R&D,
manufacturing and quality.”
“We recently concluded a US FDA audit at the Gagillapur site, The inspection
progressed constructively, and the observations are of a nature that we believe can be
fully addressed through our responses and corrective and preventive actions and we
will continue to engage transparently with the agency.”

Growth Momentum: Granules Is Scaling Strongly 
Five reasons Granules offers durable, de-risked and sustainable growth
01
US LEADERSHIP
#1 in 11
US products ranked #1, out of 38
Entrenched leadership in the world’s largest generics market
Top-3 in 19 of 38 US products (IQVIA MAT Aug’26), up from 18. North America is 72% with a 
revenue growth of 14% YoY, backed by a US controlled-substances franchise.
02
FTF OPTIONALITY
3
Potential sole FTF ANDAs filed
A pipeline built for high-value early launches
Amphetamine ER ODT, Sodium Oxybate ER and Ruxolitinib ER, plus 26 pending ANDAs 
(CNS/CII - 3, Complex OSD - 10, ONCO - 2, Integrated – 10, others – 1) in a TAM ~$35 Bn US 
market. The Para IV and Day-1 playbook adds upside to the base business.
03
COMPLEX Gx
49%
Complex Gx H1FY27 share of FD 
portfolio
A portfolio moving steadily up the value chain
Complex Gx H1FY27 revenue grew by 45% YoY, with 67 dossiers filed under complex category 
and 30 awaiting approval. 
The Senn Chemicals acquisition adds Peptide CDMO as a second, higher-value growth engine.

Management Commentary
“Our Quarterly revenue has crossed ₹1500 Cr in Q2 FY27 with EBITDA of ₹338 Cr,
despite higher input and logistics costs from tensions in West Asia. Cost pressures will
persist and we are working with customers to manage them with a lag. We filed two
potential first-to-file ANDAs in H1, which makes it a total of three potential first to file
ANDAs and continue to shift towards complex generics and peptide CDMO. With the
balance warrant proceeds received, we hold net cash of ₹828 Cr to invest in R&D,
manufacturing and quality.”

progressed constructively, and the observations are of a nature that we believe can be
fully addressed through our responses and c

orrective and preventive actions and we
will continue to engage transparently with the agency.”
